HIGHER EDUCATION COMMISSION
HIGHER EDUCATION COMMISSION
EMPLOYEES (RECRUITMENT)
RULES, 2009
(Amendment of Schedules I and
III)
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part II,
8th August, 2011]
S.R.O.91(KE/2011,
dated 15-2-2011.---In exercise of the powers conferred by sub-rule (3) of rule
4 of Higher Education Commission Employees (Recruitment) Rules, 2009, the
following amendments shall be made in Schedules I and III of the rules,
notified vide S.R.O. 822(I)/2009 dated 1st September, 2009;--
In
the aforementioned Recruitment rules:--
(a) In
the table of Schedule-I, against S. No.5, for the post of Member (BPS-22), for
the entries in columns (3) and (4), the figures and symbols "50%" and
"50%" respectively shall be substituted; and
(b) In
the table of Schedule-III, for the existing entries against S.No.6, for the
post of Member (BPS-22), the following shall be substituted, namely:
Sr. No.

Ph.D. degree in any discipline with 22 years experience
of teaching/ research/ management/leadership/ administration in BPS-17 and
above or equivalent including 5 years experience in BPS-20 and above or
equivalent in Government/Semi Government/Public Sector
Organization/Autonomous Body/Corporation. Experience with management of
